milestone: M2.8 Direct 10K GPU08 run; v2 failure record
outcome: GPU08 与本地 SGLang 服务启动成功，但没有派发任何人口推理请求。DeepSeek-V4 检查点没有 Hugging Face chat_template，驱动在首个请求构造阶段停止。

failure.message: ValueError: Cannot use chat template functions because tokenizer.chat_template is not set and no template argument was passed!
failure.evidence: output/population.log; population directory has only population.json and no journal.sqlite, budget.sqlite, receipt, or model attempt
failure.root_cause: The v3 token counter unconditionally called AutoTokenizer.apply_chat_template. This DeepSeek-V4 checkpoint ships without a Hugging Face chat_template; its SGLang serving image implements the DSV4 chat renderer internally.

fix.status: 已实现；102/102 项测试通过；源码已冻结并推送；报告快照时尚未提交新的 GPU08 作业。
fix.approach: Use the exact image-provided SGLang 0.5.16 DSV4 encode_messages renderer before tokenizer.encode; freeze thinking_mode=thinking and pass chat_template_kwargs.thinking=true in each request.

verification.unit_tests: 102/102 项通过，覆盖原生 DSV4 编码器选择及缺少模板时 fail-closed 行为

limitations: No Navier–Stokes prompt reached the model and no population phase ran.
This attempt is an engineering failure, not an independent population replicate.
The next run must use a new population ID and source identity; v3 files and Slurm evidence remain immutable.
